nos.title: Handle hand and power tools relevant to construction electrical works

elements.title: Handle hand/power tools for electrical works.

pcs.text: perform basic checks on power tools prior to use
handle hand/power tools for establishing/ terminating electrical connections as per requirement
use appropriate tools to trace out short circuits/faults and leakages in electrical wiring
use measuring instruments to measure size and dimension of wires, conduits as per electrical installation or maintenance work requirement
use hand/ power tools to cut, and bend wire and conduit as per electrical installation or maintenance work requirement
use appropriate tools to splice wires by stripping insulation from terminal leads and twisting wires together
use appropriate hand/power tools to thread conduit ends, connect couplings, and fabricate and secure conduit support brackets
use appropriate electrical measuring devices like ammmeter, voltmeter,meggers etc.to examine electrical units for power interruptions/ continuity
use electrical devices such as starters, circuit breakers, relays as per equipment/ wiring installation rating or current rating
use diagnostic devices like multi-meter, tong tester, earth tester or similar devices to install, repair power connections
perform maintenance and upkeep of relevant tools and devices after use

nos.title: Install temporary lighting arrangement at construction sites

elements.title: Installation of temporary lighting arrangement at construction sites

pcs.text: check cable, conduits , lights, sockets, temporary power distribution panels at power source and other required fixtures and accessories as per manufacturers guidelines and specification
lay cables through ducts or conduits, underground or through poles (overhead) as per plans and instructions
select the type and wattage of lights considering illumination requirement at worksite and install them at secured positions

fix lights and its accessories, brackets, bulkheads with screws and bolts or by other standard means, pull wires through conduit leading to connection boxes, temporary panels/ distribution boards or other temporary electrical terminals
extend/ join LV electrical cable using straight through joints, splicing them together and secure joints by applying PVC insulation tapes, caps or by other safe method as and when necessary
carry out termination of LV cables selecting the right method as per standard practice
work safely as per electrical safety guidelines provided by manufacturer, standard safety practice or organizational safety norms while establishing or disconnecting live electrical connections
upkeep of all relevant key electrical tools and fixtures
tag embedded, exposed electrical lines and other key equipment appropriately
shift light at various locations during construction activity as per requirement
repair and replace light arrangements as per instruction or requirement
replace burned out bulbs, light units and ballast in light fixtures as needed
carry out relevant tests to trace out power interruptions/ continuity at lighting arrangements
replace damaged cable, other relevant parts as and when necessary
replace faulty circuit breakers, fuses, switches, electrical and electronic components and wire as per requirement
perform preventive maintenance on diesel generators at site provided for temporary lighting (if any) at scheduled intervals as per direction of concerned authority

nos.title: Assist in LV (Low Voltage) electrical wiring at permanent structures

elements.title: Provide assistance for LV electrical wiring work in permanent structures

pcs.text: select house wiring components (such as wires flexible and rigid conduits, PVC raceways wooden battens, clamps etc according to their specification size
read and interpret single phase LV wiring diagram
carry out necessary linear measurement to cut bend join conduits and cables and use them as per requirement or instruction
lay conduit through RCC structures (slabs beams walls) or through chased wall (brick wall) surface as per instruction
lock conduit pipe in its location by means of clamp or other standard means as per instruction
pull, push wires through conduits in order to expose them at desired locations as per requirement
perform drilling and cutting using appropriate tools as per requirement
handle shift and assist in fixing electrical fixtures and fittings as per instructions
carry out termination of cables safely as per instruction
test electrical circuit during and post wiring activity using appropriate tools as per direction of electrician
assist in carrying out electrical earthing work by installing earthing components as per instructions

nos.title: Assemble, install and maintain temporary LV electrical panels (distribution boards) at construction site

elements.title: Assemble temporary LV power distribution panels (distribution boards)
Repair/ replace faulty parts/ fixtures as per requirement

pcs.text: read relevant SLDs(Single Line Diagrams), instructions, safety guidelines, manufacturers specifications prior to assembling temporary panel/ distribution boards
install required fixtures like power sockets, switches, wires, MCBs(Miniature Circuit Breakers) of appropriate specification as per circuit load requirement
ensure tightness and safe working condition of wires, fixtures prior to the connection of the assembly with power source
connect DB (Distribution Board) to main power cable and perform standard tests to ensure its safe and desired working
place and secure the distribution board against external damaging agents like water, fire etc
carry out proper termination of cables as per standard practice while connecting to the sockets of the panel
carry out earthing of the panels as per standard procedure
check and ensure necessary tagging and barrication near the live/ active electrical distribution boards
carry out visual inspection of the live/ active board regularly to ensure safe working condition of all components
ensure that the live connections get discontinued after completion of daily construction works in order to minimize energy wastage and enhance working efficiency of electrical units
respond promptly to failure/ damage or malfunctioning of panel or any of its components
carry out necessary tests in order to determine root cause of failure
notify concerned authorities prior to shut down, deactivation or repair of the electrical unit
replace/ repair faulty components as per SLD, instructions, safety guidelines and manufacturers specifications
document and keep records relevant to maintenance/ repair of panels as per organizational norms
isolate the panel safely and shift to another location as per requirement

nos.title: Work according to personal health, safety and environment protocols at construction site

elements.title: Follow safety norms as defined by the organization
Follow infection control guidelines as per applicability

pcs.text: identify and report any hazards, risks or breaches in site safety to the appropriate authority
follow emergency and evacuation procedures in case of accidents, fires, natural calamities
follow recommended safe practices in handling construction materials, including chemical and hazardous material whenever applicable
follow all the protocols and safety techniques conveyed during safety awareness programs like Tool Box Talks, safety demonstrations and mock drills conducted at the site
select and operate different types of fire extinguishers corresponding to various types of fires as per EHS guideline
identify near miss, unsafe condition and unsafe act

use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) as per work requirements for : Head Protection, Ear protection, Fall Protection ,Foot Protection, Face and Eye Protection, Hand and Body Protection , and Respiratory Protection (if required)
handle all required tools, tackles, materials and equipment safely
follow safe disposal of waste, harmful and hazardous materials as per EHS guidelines
check and install all safety equipment as per standard guidelines
follow safety protocols and practices as laid down by site EHS department
obtain "height pass" clearance for working at heights
collect, segregate and deposit construction waste into appropriate containers based on their toxicity or hazardous nature
apply ergonomic principles wherever required
follow recommended personal hygiene, workplace hygiene and sanitization practices
clean and disinfect all materials, tools and supplies before and after use
report immediately to concerned authorities regarding signs and symptoms of illness of self and others

nos.title: Work effectively in a team to deliver desired results at the workplace

elements.title: Interact and communicate in an effective manner
Support co-workers to execute the project requirements

pcs.text: pass on work related information/ requirement clearly to the team members
inform co-workers and superiors about any kind of deviations from work
report any unresolved problem to the supervisor immediately
obtain instructions from superiors and respond on the same
communicate to team members/subordinates for appropriate work technique and method
seek clarification and advice as per the requirement
hand over the required material, tools, tackles, equipment and work fronts timely to interfacing teams
work together with co-workers in a synchronized manner
maintain cultural inclusivity at work place
maintain disability friendly work practices
follow gender neutral practices at workplace
address discriminatory and offensive behaviour in a professional manner as per organizational policy

nos.title: Plan and organize work to meet expected outcomes

elements.title: Organise required resources as per work plan
Complete work as per the plan

pcs.text: identify the targets and timelines set by superiors
determine the work requirements corresponding to task(drawings/schedules/instructions/methodology), safety, tools and equipment prior to commencement of task
plan the work by analyzing the required outcomes, work procedures, allotted time, resource availability and known priorities
prepare the work areas in coordination with team members
plan for waste collection and disposal prior to and after completion of work
arrange the required manpower prior to commencement of work
organize the required materials, tools and tackles required for the task
engage allocated manpower in an appropriate manner
employ correct tools, tackles and equipment for the desired work
provide guidance to the subordinates to obtain desired outcome
use resources in an optimum manner to avoid any unnecessary wastage
use tools, tackles and equipment carefully to avoid damage
ensure the work processes adopted are in line with the specified standards and instructions
complete the work with the allocated resources within specified time
clean and organise the workplace after completion of task

elements.title: Becoming a Professional in the 21st Century

pcs.text: understand the significance of employability skills in meeting the job requirements
identify constitutional values, civic rights, duties, personal values and ethics and environmentally sustainable practices

explain 21st Century Skills such as Self-Awareness, Behavior Skills, Positive attitude, self- motivation, problem-solving, creative thinking, time management, social and cultural awareness, emotional awareness, continuous learning mindset etc.
speak with others using some basic English phrases or sentences
follow good manners while communicating with others
work with others in a team
communicate and behave appropriately with all genders and PwD
report any issues related to sexual harassment
use various financial products and services safely and securely
calculate income, expenses, savings etc.
approach the concerned authorities for any exploitation as per legal rights and laws
operate digital devices and use its features and applications securely and safely
use internet and social media platforms securely and safely
identify and assess opportunities for potential business
identify sources for arranging money and associated financial and legal challenges
identify different types of customers
identify customer needs and address them appropriately
follow appropriate hygiene and grooming standards
create a basic biodata
search for suitable jobs and apply
identify and register apprenticeship opportunities as per requirement
